tuning: no test tuning; every deviation is a declared source-based adaptation
_role: S-C48 (epoch 65) as the common base for the seven loops, state = 48 B-spline controls; constraints are evaluated on the decoded curve p(u)=B(u)Q and mapped back exactly by J_Q = -(B[:,1:-1]*grad). 16-level native schedule only.

adaptations.state: control space: the optimisation variable is the 46 free control points of the 48-point clamped cubic B-spline; the delivered object is the decoded curve. PaperTask.constraints evaluates the SDF on 128 decoded curve points and returns J_Q = -(B[:,1:-1]*grad_p), the exact adjoint of p=B Q.
adaptations.constraint_points: 128 = the codec's own curve resolution (bspline.curve_points), i.e. the same sampling density the model decodes to. The independent evaluation uses 512 points.
adaptations.field_kind: bilinear MapConstraint (same field as the point-space seven-method tables); the S-C48 baseline itself is scored by adapters/unified_curve_eval.py at 512 points.
adaptations.schedule: T=16 native, never re-timed to 256. cd_levels=16 means every trained level is visited once (eq.(6) uses that level's own beta_t).
adaptations.pdm_step_convention: official_ald, eps derived so that gamma/sigma^2 = 1/6. The paper's gamma_t=sigma_t^2/(2 sigma_T^2) on this 16-level schedule gives a mixing rate of 1/(2 sigma_T^2)=4.7e-6, i.e. no movement in M steps.
adaptations.pdm_inner: 20 instead of M=100, permitted by PDM App. F.
adaptations.pdm_parameterization: ve (paper state); the VP-state variant is refused by the runner.
adaptations.segment_constraints_for: empty: this is the per-vertex (decoded-curve point) variant, directly comparable to the point-space tables. A control-space segment variant needs its own adapter because adjacent control points are NOT curve segments.
adaptations.cbf: SafeDiffuser official: one QP per level on the sampled next state, h = Lfb + k*b, G = -grad b, Q = I, ReS slack weight 100 outside the hard interval (vendored, algorithms/official/safediffuser.py). No substeps, no certificate, no gate, no step cap.
adaptations.dual_eta_rho: paper App. C 'large' eta=1e-3, rho=2.5e-4 divided by dual_constraint_scale^2=16384 (lambda'=lambda/s, eta'=eta/s^2).
adaptations.timeouts: 180 s per single-particle method, 300 s for the 4-particle Primal-Dual/ALM, 900 s for PDM.
adaptations.cbf_hard_slack: Thm 3.5 的 w=0（硬区间无松弛）只在约束行与状态变量一一对应（点空间可分离）时可用。控制点空间下 J 是耦合的（一个控制点影响 128 个曲线点），硬系统实测不可行/超迭代，因此硬区间也保留 eq.(13) 的松弛项。
adaptations.relax_weight: cbf_velocity 里 w 是松弛惩罚的**反比**（objective 里 slack 项系数 = 1/(2w^2)）：w=100 => 1/(2e4)=5e-5，松弛几乎免费，CBF 退化为不干预（实测 RoS/ReS/TVS 与无约束基线逐位相同）；这里取 w=0.01 => 5000，松弛很贵，约束近似硬约束。点空间表格沿用 w=100，该差异在报告中标注。
adaptations.cbf_relaxation: RoS/ReS/TVS use the existing cbf_velocity with w=relax_weight=100 and cbf_hard_slack. Measured: at this scale the slack penalty is 1/(2*100^2)=5e-5, so the relaxation is almost free and the CBF is numerically inactive -- the three SafeDiffuser rows are bit-identical to the unconstrained baseline (2/20 collisions). Three other scales were tried and are all unusable: w=0 (hard) makes the coupled control-space system infeasible / hits OSQP max_iter; w=0.01 (strong penalty) makes the L-BFGS-B elimination path fail with qp_relaxed_residual_failed; an explicit-slack OSQP (rho=1e4, eps=1e-9) needs >180 s per sample. See docs/sc48_seven_methods_report.md section 3.
adaptations.cbf_substeps: 控制点空间的 CBF QP 每次求解约 0.1-0.5 s（OSQP，256 行 x 220 变量），因此 substeps=1：步长由 cbf_max_point_step 的逐点上限继续约束。点空间审计已证明 substeps 16->1 结果不变（cbf_max_point_step 主导）。

validation_selection: Frozen20 equally spaced validation indices; the same 20 scenes as every earlier table; no outcome selection.
base_model_note: S-C48 = outputs/models/oneshot_k4p_c48_s/ckpt/best_task.pt (epoch 65, train.feedback.rollout=false). Requires the code at commit c1d97bf^ (see docs/sc48_recovery_audit.md): the current HEAD SceneCNN/FeedbackEncoder cannot load it faithfully.
